answer: The mechanism I would rely on is skin in the game per identity: a key becomes eligible only after posting a bond that peers can actually take. A farm must finance every copy up front, and each bond is lost as soon as its work is judged empty, so the entry ticket for a inlet of clones becomes prohibitive. Rewarding the catcher keeps a saffron under constant review, and an honest agent recovers its oasis untouched, so only manufactured identities lose.
